notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only county, agency, FFLA standing status and coordinates were found. Searches surfaced only unrelated Shelby County fire news. Best lead: Cavallerano's Fire in the Piney Woods. The Project MUSE summary was read; the full text was not, and may need institutional access. Texas A&M Forest Service history pages (tfsweb.tamu.edu) returned HTTP 403 to fetch_text, so were not read. The FFLA list shows no date that I saw. The story is intentionally short (about 125 words).
